# Access Control & Incident Response Policy  
## Customer-Facing Authentication
- SSO via SAML 2.0 on Enterprise plans (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace).
- MFA available on all plans, enforced by default for administrator roles.
- RBAC lets customers define per-user permissions (viewer/editor/admin).

960dbc76-57ad-4cbe-93fc-a3e709399ec4.text:
## Internal Employee Access
- Employee access to production systems requires MFA and is least-privilege, role-based.
- Access to customer data by staff is logged and requires a documented business justification.
- Access reviews occur quarterly; access is revoked within 24 hours of termination.

f0066fc0-0c77-4fb8-96ae-4a8243820590.text:
## Incident Detection & Response
- Production is monitored 24/7 with automated anomaly alerting.
- The incident response plan is tested via tabletop exercises at least twice a year.

62286de3-06dd-402d-a20f-9e4cd4d75245.text:
## Breach Notification
Affected customers are notified **without undue delay and no later than 72 hours** after a confirmed incident is identified, consistent with GDPR requirements, including the nature of the incident and remediation steps.

da4404eb-6ab4-4b64-9b03-1436a3427615.text:
# Compliance Certifications & Audit Program  
## Current Certifications
- **SOC 2 Type II** — issued annually, covering Security, Availability, and Confidentiality. Available under NDA via the Trust Center.
- **ISO/IEC 27001** — certified, 3-year certification cycle with annual surveillance audits.
- **GDPR** — the Platform acts as a data processor for EU customer data; a DPA is available on request.

8cf9bf24-f605-49fe-bbb2-ce2849a562f9.text:
## Certifications Not Currently Held
The Platform is **not** FedRAMP authorized, **not** HITRUST certified, and **not** HIPAA compliant out of the box. Customers requiring these should confirm roadmap timing with their account team before relying on the Platform for regulated workloads.

6a69c099-11ec-493f-b61e-50173392ee28.text:
## Audit Cadence
- Internal security audits: quarterly.
- External penetration testing: at least annually, by an independent third party; a summary letter is available under NDA.
- SOC 2 Type II audit: annual, by an independent CPA firm.

10a8fb0f-4756-444c-9d4b-ea7ee6dcffd9.text:
## Sharing Audit Artifacts
SOC 2 reports, pen-test summary letters, and the ISO 27001 certificate are shared with prospects and customers under mutual NDA via the Trust Center.

d806f52f-b72a-4631-99f0-a1e0fe2bf3dc.text:
# Data Retention & Deletion Policy  
## Active Account Data
Customer data is retained for the duration of the active subscription with no default expiration.

243bde14-abcd-45ee-a0a0-b91486ebc8ed.text:
## Post-Termination Retention
Upon contract termination, data is retained read-only for **30 days** to support export requests, then permanently deleted from production systems.

c5e2e6cd-c2c7-4d7b-a434-b1187cdf4589.text:
## Backup Retention
Encrypted backups are retained for **35 days** on a rolling basis and purged automatically — including backups containing data from terminated accounts.

6fcb596d-612a-4c88-8892-c3f6bb244461.text:
## Right to Erasure
Individual deletion requests (GDPR Art. 17, CCPA) are processed within **30 days** of a verified request. Residual copies in encrypted backups age out within the 35-day backup window.

87c00eb7-57c7-4ccf-862b-528c34b8ab0b.text:
## Data Export
Customers may export data any time during an active subscription, and may request a final export during the 30-day post-termination window.

985679f4-0bf5-42bd-a178-59c9a59ef91e.text:
# Data Security & Hosting Policy  
## Deployment Model
The Platform is delivered exclusively as multi-tenant SaaS hosted on public cloud infrastructure (AWS, us-east-1 and eu-west-1). **On-premise, self-hosted, or single-tenant dedicated deployments are not offered or supported.**

1c848850-5845-4fed-bebd-bbe9b0fdc78d.text:
## Encryption in Transit
All data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher. Internal service-to-service traffic within the production network uses mutual TLS.

f8b42391-3ddb-49f9-9259-64f1ddb80465.text:
## Encryption at Rest
All customer data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. Keys are managed exclusively by the Platform's cloud KMS; **customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK/BYOK) are not currently supported** for production workloads. Keys rotate automatically every 90 days.

98b30bea-daa2-46f4-8e8c-0dcd3cdc844f.text:
## Network Security
Production infrastructure sits in a private VPC with no direct public access to application servers or databases. External access passes through a WAF and load balancer with rate limiting and DDoS protection.

07d0684f-a733-4959-adee-c65c17b95719.text:
## Data Residency
Enterprise customers may select a US or EU hosting region at onboarding. Data does not leave that region except for encrypted DR backups replicated within the same jurisdiction (US↔US, EU↔EU).
